prayerExcerpt.en-US: The holy youth, by his fidelity in corresponding with the divine grace, grew to be a model of virtues.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: O santo jovem, por sua fidelidade em corresponder à graça divina, tornou-se um modelo de virtudes.

meta.face: An Irish prince of Leinster of about fifty, TALL and lean, with a fair, lightly weathered complexion and a LONG face with a STRONG, ANGULAR jaw whose corners show clearly — a high, straight forehead, a LONG, HIGH-BRIDGED, gently ARCHED nose, DEEP-SET, steady grey eyes under STRAIGHT, dark brows drawn a little together, flat, lean cheeks, a WIDE, firm, thin-lipped mouth; dark-brown hair greying, cut short below the mitre; a SHORT, CLOSE-TRIMMED dark-brown BEARD streaked with grey, following the angular jaw; the look grave and resolute. Not the clean-shaven, smooth, neat-nosed malachi_armagh, the broad, white-haired columba, the long, flaxen finbarr, the square, snub-nosed gall, the big-boned, red-grey columban or the clean-shaven thomas_becket.
meta.basis: No likeness survives; the card gives him a strong, bearded, aristocratic face to stand apart from the batch's and the earlier Irish cards, the son of a king of the Uí Muiredaig (Wikipedia). Glendalough, where the book and Wikipedia make him abbot, is behind him.
